question: List out the age of users who located in Vienna, Austria obtained the badge?
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
gold: SELECT T1.Age FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'
gold0: SELECT T1.Age FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'

c.request:
List out the age of users who located in Vienna, Austria obtained the badge?
Evidence: "Vienna, Austria" is the Location
Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
c.sql: SELECT u.Age FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'

d.request: List the age of users located in Vienna, Austria who obtained a badge, and also keep the users from Vienna, Austria who have no matching record in the badges table.
d.sql: SELECT T1.Age FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'

b.request: List the age of every user whose Location is "Vienna, Austria", including users who have no matching record in the badges table (a left join from users to badges), alongside any badge they obtained
b.sql: SELECT u.Age, b.Name FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'
